solves.reasoning: (A) Norms emerge in groups 규범은 생겨남 → emerge / (B) she may prescribe the behavior → prescribe / (C) They will observe the regularity → observe. emerge—prescribe—observe = ch[0]
(A) performed the initial action → initial / (B) threaten to sanction them → sanction / (C) rational or moral reasons → rational. initial—sanction—rational = ch[1]
(A) the start of a norm occurs → start / (B) conformity is desired → desired / (C) This will cause some to conform → cause. start—desired—cause = ch[2]
④ ignore — 원문은 observe. 규칙성을 관찰한 뒤 스스로 순응하므로 무시는 반대. ①emerge ②conform ③prescribe 적절
② unwanted — 순응이 요구된다(desired)는 것을 전달하므로 원치않는은 반대. ①start ③threaten ④regularity 적절
③ prevent — 위협이 순응을 유발(cause)하므로 막다는 반대. ①initial ②communicate ④rational 적절
communicate that ___ is desired → conformity(순응). competition/silence/distance 무관
observe the ___ of behavior ... to conform → regularity(규칙성). absence/difficulty/danger 부적절
threaten to ___ them for not behaving → sanction(제재). reward/forgive/praise는 긍정이라 반대
emerge(생겨나다) 동의어 = appear. vanish 반대, remain/hide 무관
particular(특정한) 동의어 = specific. general 반대, random/common 무관
observe(관찰/알아차리다) 동의어 = notice. ignore 반대, forget/cause 무관
conform(순응) 반의어 = resist. obey/follow 동의어 함정, gather 다른 축
rational(이성적) 반의어 = emotional. logical/sensible 동의어 함정, moral 다른 축
(A) situations of this sort = 종류 / (B) sort the books by subject = 분류하다. (A)종류—(B)분류하다 = ch[3]
behave the way others behave, follow accepted rules = conform(순응). rebel/create/ignore 부적절
for either rational or ___ (morality) reasons → reasons 수식+rational과 병렬 형용사 → morality → moral
observe the ___ (regular) of behavior → the...of 사이 명사 자리 → regular → regularity
conform to this behavior ___ 이후 여러 이유 열거 → for a number of reasons
규정받을 필요 없다 + 규칙성 관찰 후 스스로 결정 → on their own. 나머지 반대
